metadata.question: Was the Swannanoa River visibly browner on October 2, 2024, than on August 30, 2024?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) near Asheville, NC along the Swannanoa River around Biltmore Village. Target dates: 2024-08-30 and 2024-10-02. Find nearest image within ±3 days, then ±7 days if needed. Fallback to Landsat 8/9 L2 within ±10 days if Sentinel-2 not available.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Apply standard cloud masking: for S2 use QA60 cloud/cirrus bits; for Landsat L2 use QA_PIXEL bits (dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, shadow, snow). Isolate water using NDWI > 0.1. Compute a turbidity proxy NDTI = (Red - Green) / (Red + Green). More turbid/brown water tends to have higher NDTI.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection sizes; if none after attempts -> C1.
- After masking, compute water pixel counts; if 0 for any date -> C2.
- Validate NDTI values are not null and within [-1.5, 1.5]; otherwise -> C3.
- Decide: If NDTI(Oct 2) - NDTI(Aug 30) > 0.01 -> A (Yes), else -> B (No).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res);
      });
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const targetA = ee.Date('2024-08-30');
  const targetB = ee.Date('2024-10-02');

  // AOI around Biltmore Village (Swannanoa River), Asheville, NC
  const centerLon = -82.5417;
  const centerLat = 35.5656;
  const aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([centerLon - 0.01, centerLat - 0.008, centerLon + 0.01, centerLat + 0.008]);

  // 2. Helpers: Collections and selection
  function s2Collection(windowDays) {
    return function(date) {
      const start = date.advance(-windowDays, 'day');
      const end = date.advance(windowDays, 'day');
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
    };
  }

  function addDelta(col, date) {
    return col.map(function(img) {
      const delta = ee.Number(img.date().difference(date, 'day')).abs();
      return img.set('deltaDays', delta);
    });
  }

  function maskS2Clouds(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloudBit = 10;
    const cirrusBit = 11;
    const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << cloudBit).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << cirrusBit).eq(0));
    return img.updateMask(cloudMask);
  }

  function landsatCollection(windowDays) {
    return function(date) {
      const start = date.advance(-windowDays, 'day');
      const end = date.advance(windowDays, 'day');
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(aoi).filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 80));
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(aoi).filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 80));
      return l8.merge(l9);
    };
  }

  function maskLsClouds(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    // Bits: 1=Dilated, 2=Cirrus, 3=Cloud, 4=Cloud shadow, 5=Snow
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }

  function scaleLsSR(img) {
    const scaled = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5'])
      .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
      .rename(['blue','green','red','nir']);
    return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
  }

  async function selectNearestImage(date) {
    // Try S2 within ±3, then ±7
    let col = addDelta(s2Collection(3)(date), date).sort('deltaDays').sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE');
    let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      col = addDelta(s2Collection(7)(date), date).sort('deltaDays').sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE');
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    }
    if (size > 0) {
      const img = ee.Image(col.first());
      return {img: img, sensor: 'S2'};
    }
    // Fallback to Landsat within ±5 then ±10
    col = addDelta(landsatCollection(5)(date), date).sort('deltaDays').sort('CLOUD_COVER');
    size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      col = addDelta(landsatCollection(10)(date), date).sort('deltaDays').sort('CLOUD_COVER');
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    }
    if (size > 0) {
      const img = ee.Image(col.first());
      return {img: img, sensor: 'LS'};
    }
    return null;
  }

  function computeStats(img, sensor) {
    let work = img;
    let cloudProp = ee.Number(0);
    let scale = 10;
    if (sensor === 'S2') {
      work = maskS2Clouds(work);
      cloudProp = ee.Number(work.get('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE'));
      // Rename to standard
      work = work.select(['B2','B3','B4','B8'], ['blue','green','red','nir']);
      scale = 10;
    } else {
      work = maskLsClouds(work);
      cloudProp = ee.Number(work.get('CLOUD_COVER'));
      work = scaleLsSR(work); // ensures bands scaled and renamed
      scale = 30;
    }
    // Water mask via NDWI = (green - nir)/(green + nir)
    const ndwi = work.expression('(g - n) / (g + n)', {'g': work.select('green'), 'n': work.select('nir')}).rename('ndwi');
    const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.1);
    // NDTI = (red - green)/(red + green)
    const ndti = work.expression('(r - g) / (r + g)', {'r': work.select('red'), 'g': work.select('green')}).rename('ndti')
      .updateMask(waterMask);
    // Count valid water pixels and mean ndti
    const countDict = ndti.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const meanDict = ndti.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const px = ee.Number(countDict.get('ndti'));
    const mean = ee.Number(meanDict.get('ndti'));
    const imgDate = img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd');
    return {px: px, mean: mean, cloudProp: cloudProp, imgDate: imgDate};
  }

  try {
    console.log('AOI center: 35.5656, -82.5417 (Biltmore Village, Asheville)');

    // Select images
    const selA = await selectNearestImage(targetA);
    const selB = await selectNearestImage(targetB);

    if (!selA || !selB) {
      console.log(`Images A found: ${selA ? 1 : 0}, B found: ${selB ? 1 : 0}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Basic collection confirmation
    // Compute stats
    const statsA = computeStats(selA.img, selA.sensor);
    const statsB = computeStats(selB.img, selB.sensor);

    const [dateA, sensorA, cloudA, pxA, meanA] = await Promise.all([
      getInfoAsync(statsA.imgDate),
      selA.sensor,
      getInfoAsync(statsA.cloudProp),
      getInfoAsync(statsA.px),
      getInfoAsync(statsA.mean)
    ]);

    const [dateB, sensorB, cloudB, pxB, meanB] = await Promise.all([
      getInfoAsync(statsB.imgDate),
      selB.sensor,
      getInfoAsync(statsB.cloudProp),
      getInfoAsync(statsB.px),
      getInfoAsync(statsB.mean)
    ]);

    console.log(`A target 2024-08-30 -> ${sensorA} ${dateA}, cloudProp=${cloudA !== null ? cloudA.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%`);
    console.log(`B target 2024-10-02 -> ${sensorB} ${dateB}, cloudProp=${cloudB !== null ? cloudB.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%`);

    // Check C2
    if (!pxA || !pxB || pxA === 0 || pxB === 0) {
      console.log(`Water px A: ${pxA || 0}, B: ${pxB || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Check C3 (invalid means)
    const invalidA = (meanA === null || isNaN(meanA) || meanA < -1.5 || meanA > 1.5);
    const invalidB = (meanB === null || isNaN(meanB) || meanB < -1.5 || meanB > 1.5);
    if (invalidA || invalidB) {
      console.log(`NDTI A: ${meanA}, NDTI B: ${meanB}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const delta = meanB - meanA;

    console.log(`A: water px=${pxA}, NDTI=${meanA.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`B: water px=${pxB}, NDTI=${meanB.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`Delta NDTI (B-A)=${delta.toFixed(3)}`);

    // Decision: "visibly browner" -> higher NDTI by > 0.01
    if (delta > 0.01) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
